recentItems.title: We went shopping at a store run by a robot
recentItems.description: Chinese robotics company Galbot has opened three "autonomous" shops run by a humanoid robot in Hong Kong. CNN's Stephanie Yang visits to see what they can and can't do. #cnn #news #robots

recentItems.title: Congressman on Trump's 100+ posting spree: 'It's unhinged'
recentItems.description: In an interview with CNN's Erin Burnett, Rep. Robert Garcia (R-CA) reacts to Trump's social media posting spree over the holiday weekend.

recentItems.title: Three jurors in the Lindsay Clancy trial speak out
recentItems.description: In an exclusive interview with NBC 10 Boston, jurors from the Lindsay Clancy trial spoke about their experience attempting to reach a final verdict in the case. The jurors said they knew Lindsay admitted to killing the children, but they were trying to figure out if she knew right from wrong at the time. The judge ultimately declared a mistrial after one male juror was unwilling to find Clancy not guilty by lack of criminal responsibility.

recentItems.title: Ted Cruz says US in 'military conflict' with Iran, not at war
recentItems.description: In an interview with CNN's Kaitlan Collins, Sen. Ted Cruz (R-TX) avoided calling the Iran war a "war," but instead a “military conflict."

recentItems.title: Saudi oil attacked, US strikes Iran’s tankers & more | Experts on Iran
recentItems.description:
Iran-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen launched a major attack on southwestern Saudi Arabia early Tuesday, targeting oil and other infrastructure in an escalation that risks widening the region’s conflicts and adding further pressure to crude prices.

This comes as the United States struck three Iranian crude oil carriers after the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) launched ballistic missiles toward two US Navy warships over the weekend.

CNN talks to military and regional experts about the latest developments from the Iran war.

recentItems.title: Patrick Clancy threatens legal action against conspiracy theorists
recentItems.description: Lawyers for Lindsay Clancy’s ex-husband, Patrick Clancy, issued a statement saying they will take legal action to stop the barrage of online conspiracy theorists who suggest he played a role in the deaths of his three children. CNN’s Kara Scannell reports.

recentItems.title: Details from Corie Walsh’s first court appearance
recentItems.description: Corie Walsh, the 40-year-old Illinois woman with a reported interest in Lindsay Clancy’s case was ordered to be held in jail Tuesday morning. Walsh is facing three counts of first-degree murder of her 2-year-old son, who was discovered in the basement of the family home on September 1. CNN’s Whitney Wild reports from outside the courthouse in Joliet, Illinois.

recentItems.title: US strikes 5 Iranian tankers near Kharg Island
recentItems.description:
The US targeted multiple Iranian tankers near Kharg Island in the Strait of Hormuz on Tuesday, according to two US officials.

One of the officials said US forces struck the Iranian tankers tied to the Islamic Revolutionary Guards Corps in response to attempted m
missile attacks on a US Navy warship.

recentItems.title: Head of Smithsonian to retire before the end of the year
recentItems.description: The head of the Smithsonian Institution Lonnie Bunch III has announced he will retire — the role placed him at the very center of President Trump’s effort to re-shape the world’s largest museum institution. CNN’s René Marsh reports.
